diagnosis: CurrentSubscriptionBillingView applies cache_page to the dispatch method without method_decorator(vary_on_headers('Authorization')). Because DRF authenticates callers via Bearer tokens in the Authorization header, caching solely on the request URI caches the billing statement of the first organization that calls the endpoint and serves it to all subsequent organizations hitting the API.
exploit_request:
GET /api/billing/current-statement/ HTTP/1.1
Host: saas.cloudservice.net
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_b_jwt_token>
Accept: application/json
